description: A2 (c220) GDN chunk backward (GDR, scalar per-head gate): the shipped 8-kernel v1 chain replay -> reverse_rec -> reverse_dq/dbeta/dg/dk_bz/dk_ddr -> group_reduce. Public inputs/outputs are token-major fp32. Emits dh0 (§1.4). It is a pure-vector sequential per-token recurrence — zero matmul, zero barrier(Pipe.M) — a structural deviation from the §2-planned cube finalize/wu; see docs/research/a2_gdn_abi.md §7 Deviation 2 for the deviation and its ~10x perf gap vs fla's chunk-parallel Triton backward.

g.note: GDR per-(token,value-head) scalar gate (log space, g<=0).

dht.note: optional final-state cotangent; zero when absent (§1.4). At least one of do/dht must be present.

default.reason: fp32 vs autograd and the analytical adjoint. Measured dq/dk/dv/dbeta/dg/dh0 rel-L2 1.56e-7..5.15e-7 across zero and nonzero dht; judged in fp32 (AGENTS.md §6).

domain.block_dim_note: Validated at block_dim=40; see the forward contract for the bd1 fault note. Correctness is block-dim-independent (per-(b,hv) split, no cross-core reduction).
domain.accumulate_settle: The shipped chain carries no L0C accumulate (pure vector, zero matmul); there are therefore no barrier(Pipe.M) sites. This is Deviation 2 vs the §2 plan (which sited barriers after a cube finalize/wu).

dependencies.derived_from: a5.gdn_chunk_bwd (this repository); re-authored for the A2 facade.

support.scope: 910B3, CANN 9.2.0-beta.1, opp 9.2.0-beta.1, npu-smi 25.5.1, block_dim=40. The 8-kernel chain is validated end-to-end by tests/test_a2_gdn_chunk.py against autograd: dq/dk/dv/dbeta/dg/dh0 rel-L2 1.56e-7..5.15e-7 at HV!=H (H=2,HV=4), zero and nonzero dht. Raw numbers in ../gdn_chunk_fwd/evidence/acceptance_numbers.log.
support.note: Runnable unit.py / run.py / _unit_runner.py harness not yet ported; the committed pytest is the validation of record. The adjoint oracle is autograd (ref/reference.py::analytical), which does not slot into the CPU-reference unit protocol as cleanly as the forward's. The runner port is DEFERRED to a follow-up task with PM approval (PR #138 REVIEW, 2026-10-07); until it lands this unit is NOT marked qualified in the full repo unit-protocol sense.

deviations: The shipped backward is the sim-imposed 8-kernel v1 chain, pure vector (zero matmul, zero barrier(Pipe.M)), not the §40 planned 3-kernel or the §2 cube finalize/wu structure (docs/research/a2_gdn_abi.md §7 Deviation 2). Correct vs autograd; ~10x slower than fla's chunk-parallel Triton backward (algorithmic, not tuning).
The checkpoints / fused-reduce / tapeless reverse_rec_fused (v2/v3) perf variants and their informal bench were removed from the deliverable (shelved perf thread, out of A2-K1 correctness scope).

saved_state.dh0: fp32 cotangent w.r.t. the initial state [B, HV, 128, 128].
